question: What will be single discount equivalent to three successive discounts of 50%, 30% and 20%?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

If successive discount a% and b%

equivalent discount = a + b - ab/100

⇒ 50 + 30 - 50 x 30/100 = 65%

⇒ 65 + 20 - 65 x 20/100 = 72%

∴ Equivalent discount is 72%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

Successive discount = 50%, 30% and 20%

**Concept used:**

If successive discount a% and b%

equivalent discount = a + b - ab/100

**Calculation:**

Let total value = 100

First discount 50% = 100 x 50/100 = 50

⇒ Remaining = 100 - 50 = 50

Second discount 30% on remaining 50 = 50 x 30/100 = 15

⇒ Remaining = 50 - 15 = 35 

Third discount 20% on remaining 35 = 35 x 20/100 = 7

⇒ Total discount = 50 + 15 + 7 = 72%

**∴ Equivalent discount is 72%**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**Successive discount means discount on the discount. (just like Compound Interest rate= interest on interest)

If the first discount is a% and 2nd discount is b% then,

Total discount = (a + b - ab/100) %
